name: Process Docs
description: Documents covering the end-to-end delivery and takeaway business process lifecycles, including all six delivery phases, dispatch race-condition handling, pickup-time state machines, callback handler reference, and rider accept/decline flows.

name: System Guides
description: Technical reference guides for specific subsystems — live location tracking via OwnTracks, the order creation and Stripe payment lifecycle, and the async webhook URL utility with its caching strategy.

name: Interactive Tools
description: Self-contained browser-based visualization tools that let readers interactively explore delivery process phases, status transitions, and component relationships.

name: Configuration
description: Tooling configuration for the understand-anything analysis harness, controlling which documentation files are included or excluded from knowledge graph generation.
